purpose: Add something further or describe an increase beyond the current degree.
keywords: さらに + additional fact / increased degree
The price includes meals. In addition, transport is provided.
I checked it again and made further corrections.
formation: さらに + additional fact / increased degree
restrictions: Can connect sentences or intensify a changing situation.
mistake: It adds or increases; it does not introduce a contrast like しかし.
